lines.1: At the end of sixth period.
lines.4: 「Everyone, I found out. They're doing a joint lesson with Class B today and baked cookies.」
lines.6: 「Well, they're about right for an afternoon snack.」
lines.7: 「Homemade sweets, even if they're just obligation gifts. I can't wait.」
lines.8: ...Kinu might force me to eat whatever she made.
lines.9: No way. I'm not virtuous enough to eat something that terrible.
lines.10: I opened the classroom door and began my escape.
lines.11: I'd leave her to Subaru and Fukahire.
lines.13: The moment I relaxed, the executive-room door opened.
lines.15: 「Oh, good. It's you, Sato... I thought Kinu had already made it here.」
lines.16: 「Perfect timing. We made cookies in class. Want some?」
lines.17: 「Absolutely. If you made them, I'm all for it.」
lines.19: This room felt peaceful when it was just Sato and me.
lines.20: I took a bite of a cookie.
lines.22: Sato glanced up at me from beneath her lashes, watching for my reaction.
lines.25: 「Between this and Valentine's Day, you really take care of me.」
lines.26: She'd made too much while getting carried away making something for the Princess, so I'd received a big heart-shaped chocolate from her.
lines.30: Sato sat across from me, smiling as she watched me eat.
lines.32: 「It's satisfying to watch from the cook's side too. Maybe I'll make you things again sometime?」
lines.33: 「But all I do is eat them.」
lines.35: 「I-if it's for you, Tsushima... I could make as much as you want.」
lines.37: I got embarrassed too and looked away.
lines.38: ...S-she's kind to everyone. She's supposed to be.
lines.39: Taking this as affection would be getting way too full of myself.
lines.40: She probably just likes making people happy.
lines.41: 「Hm? What, only you two are here?」
lines.44: 「Ahaha. Please have some too if you'd like, Iron-senpai. I baked them myself.」
lines.45: 「I see. Sato's homemade cookies? I'm glad to hear it. I'll have one.」
lines.47: 「The tea is excellent too. Sato, you'll make a good wife.」
lines.49: For some reason, even while blushing, Sato stole a quick glance at me.
